blocks.text: Wrapwheel keeps the rhythm of winding, carrying and wrapping in one small reel. Its everyday name comes from the motion a caretaker sees; the lore book preserves the longer connection between making cloth and tending damage.
A cloth reel with a pull tab. Its strip unrolls into a wrapping loop.
One-shot use: The pull tab turns around the reel and a broad cloth strip winds outward into a large wrap. The game performs the final fade.
10 silver. Injury severity −1; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +5. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
